description_for_human: Command-line interface for Fibery workspaces — entity CRUD, schema, views, documents, automations, plus UI-discovered endpoints.
description_for_model: Use the `fibery` CLI to interact with Fibery workspaces. Read docs/AGENTS.md for the output contract and escalation rules. Read docs/CAPABILITIES.md before designing multi-step flows. Output defaults to JSON; exit codes follow sysexits.h. When the CLI returns 'method not found', 'unknown command', or a 404 on /api/*, invoke the auto-extension loop documented in README.md rather than retrying or fabricating workarounds.
